scripts.title: Axon Hub | Auto Farm, Auto Cook, Auto Serve & Auto Peel
scripts.features:
Axon Hub for Sell Fries! [Anomaly] brings Auto Farm, Auto Cook, Auto Peel, and Auto Serve together in one automated kitchen workflow. Collect potatoes, prepare fries, serve drive-thru customers, and manage upgrades while keeping track of nighttime threats.

🍟 AUTO FARM & KITCHEN AUTOMATION

- Auto Kitchen handles potato collection, peeling, frying, and serving customers.
- Auto Collect Potatoes keeps your kitchen supplied.
- Auto Peel with Instant and Scrub modes.
- Fast Peel option with configurable peeling settings.
- Auto Cook turns prepared potatoes into fries.
- Auto Serve delivers fries to waiting drive-thru customers.
- Auto Stockpile keeps cooking between customers and stores fries for upcoming orders.
- Adjustable stockpile limit.
- Choose walking or teleport movement.

👁️ ANOMALY DEFENSE & ESP

- Auto Shutter closes the drive-thru window when a possessed car arrives.
- Automatically reopen the shutter after the threat leaves.
- Night Retreat returns your character to the kitchen at night or when an anomaly approaches.
- Configurable anomaly detection radius.
- Stay Inside at Night prevents the kitchen farm from visiting the potato pile after dark.
- Auto Fix Power handles the power-box wire puzzle.
- Anomaly ESP displays threats and their distance.
- Drive-Thru ESP shows waiting cars, customer patience, and suspicious vehicles.

🔑 BASEMENT KEY & RUN COMPLETION

- Auto Key collects the basement key once it appears and unlocks the basement.
- Basement Key ESP helps locate the spawned key.
- Optional automatic basement entry to finish the run.
- Pile Cleaner collects and dumps potatoes to reduce the pile.
- Auto Return to Lobby after the run ends.

⬆️ AUTO UPGRADES & BOOSTS

- Auto Buy Tools and kitchen upgrades.
- Auto Buy Machines as they become affordable.
- Configurable upgrade priorities and minimum cash reserve.
- Auto Merchant purchases selected items.
- Auto Use Money Potion and Cola boosts.
- Auto Pick Morning Perks with a preferred perk selection.
- Auto Buy Permanent Upgrades with a configurable gem reserve.

🎁 LOBBY & REWARDS

- Auto Join Queue with team-size selection.
- Join open parties or create a friends-only queue.
- Hard Mode selection once unlocked.
- Automatically accept the game's available rejoin offer.
- Auto Claim completed achievement rewards.
- Auto Free Wheel Spin when available.

⚙️ EXTRA TOOLS

- Anti-AFK.
- Server browser, server hopping, and rejoin controls.
- Live money-per-minute, customer, and session statistics.
- Save, load, and autoload configurations.
- Automation pauses after manual movement.
